title: Lightly Spiced Indian Fregola Pilaf
description: A sweet and tender Indian dish featuring fregola, perfect for a sick day, with a salt-bake and gluten-free friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: fregola
ingredients.notes: also known as frik or berkukes

instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the fregola and stir to coat the fregola with the ghee or oil.
Add the coriander powder, turmeric, and salt, and stir well.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the fregola is cooked and the water is absorbed.
Turn off the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
